text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The decisive battle to determine the 
strongest active racer among Umamusume 
pursuing the pinnacle of "speed"—the 
Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A massive crowd had packed into Nakayama 
Racecourse, eager to catch a glimpse of 
the outcome of this lightning-fast 
showdown.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
VROOOM VROOOM VROOOM VROOOOOM!! Lady 
Ruby's on the track, WOOOO~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Everyone on the floor—wait, in the stands! 
Are ya hyped up?! Let's goooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Huh? What? Y-Yaaay... !?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayy ayyyy!! Alright, let's turn up the 
cheeeringgg!!" his

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Haha... I heard an incredible racket and 
figured it had to be Helios.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Still... the reality is, Ruby is a 
formidable opponent, Zephyr."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Even so, you――

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(...I've felt it all morning. A biting 
chill like a northwesterly wind piercing 
right through me――)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Yes, so I think this is...)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...It must be tension, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Miss Ruby. ...Good afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Good day.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(Ngh... It truly strikes right at my core. 
The aura of the heavenly wind she 
radiates—)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
In our previous training run, I only 
managed a gentle breeze... But today, 
without fail... I will show you what a 
gale I can be.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Please, feel free to do as you wish.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I, too, shall fulfill what I must do.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Supreme. Brilliant. Peerless. Absolute. 
That alone is my mission."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: That is the sole reason for my existence.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Heavy... precious. Beyond words.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: However... I――!!
